Refresh only the source hashes transitively affected by those two changes.
scientific_invariants: No training run, checkpoint, data row, optimizer, learning rate, seed, evaluation task, metric, or statistical procedure changes.

runtime_transition: Because the waiting factorial ledger contains zero steps, archive it byte-for-byte after stopping only its own controller, then restart the unchanged handoff against the refreshed source contract.
